details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase D, "Implementation steps" section (step 3) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The plan says `SERENA_QUERY`, `SERENA_FALLBACK`, and `SERENA_PROBE` all live in `scripts/setup_serena.sh` + `scripts/serena_stats_emit.py`, but `SERENA_PROBE` is emitted from `scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:87`.
  WHY: The Phase D audit would miss that callsite, so `SERENA_PROBE` would never be mirrored into the JSONL stream.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase D "Current state" section, reference to `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` (~line 270) extracting AI_PHASE_FAILURE_V1 markers | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan cites `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` (~line 270) for `AI_PHASE_FAILURE_V1` extraction, but the regex is actually at line 952.
  WHY: That line reference points readers to unrelated hot-files telemetry logic instead of the real marker-extraction code.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase D implementation step 3 — patching `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` to call `emit_event` for AUTOFIX_* prefixes | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The plan adds `emit_event` calls in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` without saying how `emit_event.sh` is sourced before those calls run.
  WHY: In workflows that source `gh_helpers.sh` without sourcing `emit_event.sh`, the helper would hit `emit_event: command not found` on the AUTOFIX_* paths.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Constraints section (§14) vs Phase F worktree GC design (~line 959) and R-X3 (~line 1351) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan says "None of the phases add new gh api callsites" / "No new GitHub API calls", but Phase F's GC pass uses `gh run list --status in_progress`.
  WHY: That makes Phase F a new GitHub API caller despite the stated constraint, even if Risk R-X3 treats it as acceptable.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Line 95 (table) and lines 1093-1094 (Phase H Current state) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan claims `docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:189-198` has an "Alternatives considered" section, and also says `docs/plans/judge-loop-and-reissue-plan.md` and `docs/plans/ai-code-review-learnings-plan.md` do too.
  WHY: The cited line range is wrong, and the latter two plans do not have those sections, so the audit evidence is inaccurate.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase D section "Implementation steps" step 3 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan attributes `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED` and `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_ISSUED` to `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`, but those prefixes are emitted in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`.
  WHY: An implementer following the audit would search the wrong file and leave the mirror wiring incomplete for those two prefixes.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase E section "Implementation steps" step 2 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Phase E treats `scripts/validate_process.sh` as part of the "three long-running phases", but the same section says only `review-editor`, `review-reviewer`, and `orchestrate-poll-judge` qualify.
  WHY: The step list and the rationale disagree, so either validate_process.sh is wrongly included or the qualifying-phase list is incomplete.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase F "Current state" (~line 876) and Implementation step 3 (~line 903) and "Files & Modules" section (~line 1274) | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan says `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh` has ad-hoc `git worktree` usage and should be patched as a worktree callsite, but the file contains no `git worktree` calls.
  WHY: That edit target is invalid, so the registry wiring would be added to a script that does not use worktrees.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase C implementation steps step 3 / Phase C, "Current state" and throughout | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan points the "issue marked complete" hook at `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`, but the completion flow that decides an issue is complete lives in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
  WHY: There is no such callsite in `orchestrate_lib.py`, so an implementer would patch the wrong file or have to rediscover the real trigger point.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase B approach step 2 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The proposed `Role:`/`Goal:` parser only handles a very specific first-line format, so future mode files with a different layout will fail parsing.
  WHY: The plan says fail-open, so those modes would silently skip identity injection and only emit a stderr parse-fail line.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase C implementation step 3 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `unblock_dependents` updates `.tasks/<wave_id>/*.json`, but the next poll cycle re-materializes state from the chunked-state comments instead of those files.
  WHY: Without a read-path cut-over, the file-level unblock has no effect on the orchestrator's decisions.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase C "Current state" and throughout | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The plan introduces `reissue_depends_on` without documenting whether this is an addition to the existing schema or a replacement for anything else.
  WHY: The existing code already uses both `depends_on` and `reissue_depends_on`, so the file-based persistence needs its relationship spelled out to avoid schema drift.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase F "Implementation steps" (Step 2) and Risk R-X3 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Constraints section (§14) explicitly states "None of the phases add new gh api callsites." However, Phase F's worktree GC mechanism explicitly requires a new `gh run list --status in_progress` call to determine which worktrees are still in use.
  WHY: When Phase F is implemented with `ORCH_WORKTREE_REGISTRY_ENABLED=true`, every GC pass will make a new GitHub API call that was not previously in the codebase, contradicting the stated §14 constraint.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Grounded current-state evidence table, Phase H row | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The table claims the "Alternatives considered" prose exists at `docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:189-198` but the actual section starts at line 130.
  WHY: This documentation inaccuracy could confuse implementers trying to verify the claim because the evidence reference points to the wrong location.
- docs/plans/learn-claude-code-learnings-plan.md:Phase C "Current state" and throughout | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The plan introduces a new field `reissue_depends_on` without documenting whether this is an addition to the existing schema or if it replaces anything.
  WHY: The existing code in orchestrate_poll_process.sh uses both `depends_on` and `reissue_depends_on`, so the relationship between the two arrays needs to be spelled out.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
